caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical box with a slightly domed lid. The box is adorned with a dense pattern of brown leaves and vines on a light beige background, which covers the entire surface of the cylinder. The edge of the lid features a decorative border containing blue and white floral motifs mixed with some brown elements. The overall coloration of the box consists of various shades of brown, beige, and hints of blue and white on the edge of the lid. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, leaving the focus solely on the box itself. There are faint pencil marks on the left side of the image, including a small arrow and some handwritten text.
title: Bandbox
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
